\newcommand{\ealkey}[1]{\textcolor{ealkeycolour}{#1}}

% One translated word above one English word. Built from kernel
% primitives, never a tabular, which would break wherever the sheet

% the two, so a long translation pushes its neighbours aside instead of

  \setlength{\ealglosswd}{\wd\ealboxen}%

  \leavevmode

    \makebox[0pt][c]{\usebox{\ealboxen}}%
    \makebox[0pt][c]{\raisebox{\ealglossraise}{\usebox{\ealboxtr}}}%
  }%
}

%------------------------------------------------------------------
% STARTER 1
%------------------------------------------------------------------
\begin{frame}[t]{Starter}
\begin{columns}[T]

\column{0.36\textwidth}
\begin{center}
\vspace{-0.9em}
{\footnotesize\textbf{Write the \ealkey{multiplier}\\ under each \ealkey{bar model}.}}\\[0.4em]
\ealpara{ہر \ealkeytr{بار ماڈل} کے نیچے \ealkeytr{ضرب کنندہ} لکھیں۔}{Write the \ealkey{multiplier} under each \ealkey{bar model}.}
\ealpara{20\% کا اضافہ؛ \ealkeytr{ضرب کنندہ}: $\times\,1.2$؛ 30\% کی کمی؛ \ealkeytr{ضرب کنندہ}: $\times\,0.7$}{Increase by $20\%$; \ealkey{Multiplier}: $\times\,1.2$; Decrease by $30\%$; \ealkey{Multiplier}: $\times\,0.7$}
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=0.66, every node/.style={font=\scriptsize}]

% ---- Increase of 20%: a bar of 12 tenths ----
\node[font=\small] at (2.4,1.75) {Increase by $20\%$};
\draw[topbrace, blue!60!black] (0,0.65) -- (4.0,0.65);
\node[blue!60!black] at (2.0,1.10) {$100\%$};
\foreach \i in {0,...,11}{
  \ifnum\i<10
    \fill[blue!30] (\i*0.4,0) rectangle ++(0.4,0.55);
  \else
    \fill[green!45] (\i*0.4,0) rectangle ++(0.4,0.55);
  \fi
  \draw (\i*0.4,0) rectangle ++(0.4,0.55);
}
\draw[bottombrace, green!50!black] (4.8,-0.10) -- (0,-0.10);
\node[green!50!black] at (2.4,-0.55) {$120\%$};
\node[font=\small] at (2.4,-1.35) {\ealkey{Multiplier}: $\times\,\ablank{1.2}$};

% ---- Decrease of 30%: a bar of 10 tenths, 3 taken away ----
\node[font=\small] at (2.0,-2.20) {Decrease by $30\%$};
\draw[topbrace] (0,-3.25) -- (4.0,-3.25);
\node at (2.0,-2.85) {$100\%$};
\foreach \i in {0,...,9}{
  \ifnum\i<7
    \fill[red!35] (\i*0.4,-3.90) rectangle ++(0.4,0.55);
  \else
    \fill[gray!20] (\i*0.4,-3.90) rectangle ++(0.4,0.55);
  \fi
  \draw (\i*0.4,-3.90) rectangle ++(0.4,0.55);
}
\draw[bottombrace, red!70!black] (2.8,-4.00) -- (0,-4.00);
\node[red!70!black] at (1.4,-4.45) {$70\%$};
\node[font=\small] at (2.0,-5.25) {\ealkey{Multiplier}: $\times\,\ablank{0.7}$};

\end{tikzpicture}
\end{center}

\column{0.64\textwidth}
\vspace{-1.8em}
\footnotesize
\begin{enumerate}\tightlist
\begin{multicols}{2}
  \item \ealpara{0.35 کو \ealkeytr{فیصد} اور \ealkeytr{کسر} کی \ealkeytr{سادہ ترین صورت} میں لکھیں۔}{Write $0.35$ as a \ealkey{percentage} and as a \ealkey{fraction} in its \ealkey{simplest form}.}
        \ashow{$35\% = \tfrac{7}{20}$}
  \columnbreak
  \item \ealpara{$\dfrac{3}{8}$ کو \ealkeytr{اعشاریہ} اور \ealkeytr{فیصد} میں لکھیں۔}{Write $\dfrac{3}{8}$ as a \ealkey{decimal} and as a \ealkey{percentage}.}
        \ashow{$0.375 = 37.5\%$}
\end{multicols}
  \item \ealpara{\ealkeytr{ضرب کنندہ جات} کا جدول مکمل کریں۔}{Complete the table of \ealkey{multipliers}.}
  \vspace{0.3em}
  \begin{center}
  {\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.25}\setlength{\tabcolsep}{6pt}
  \begin{tabular}{c|c|c}
    Change & New amount & \ealkey{Multiplier}\\ \hline
    increase of $20\%$ & $120\%$ & $1.2$\\
    increase of $5\%$  & \ablank{$105\%$} & \ablank{$1.05$}\\
    decrease of $30\%$ & $70\%$  & \ablank{$0.7$}\\
    decrease of $8\%$  & \ablank{$92\%$} & \ablank{$0.92$}
  \end{tabular}}
  \end{center}
  \vspace{0.4em}
\begin{multicols}{2}
  \item \ealpara{£240 میں 15\% اضافہ کریں۔}{Increase \pounds240 by $15\%$.}
        \ashow{$240\times1.15=$ \pounds276}
  \columnbreak
  \item \ealpara{£45 میں 30\% کمی کریں۔}{Reduce \pounds45 by $30\%$.}
        \ashow{$45\times0.7=$ \pounds31.50}
\end{multicols}
  \item \ealpara{ایک اسکول میں 850 طلباء ہیں۔ تعداد میں 6\% اضافہ ہوتا ہے۔ اب کتنے طلباء ہیں؟}{A school has 850 pupils. The roll rises by $6\%$. How many pupils now?}
        \ashow{$850\times1.06=901$ pupils}
  \item \ealpara{ٹوبی کہتا ہے ``10\% کا اضافہ $\times1.1$ ہے، تو 10\% کی کمی $\times0.1$ ہے''۔ وضاحت کریں کہ وہ کیوں غلط ہے اور درست \ealkeytr{ضرب کنندہ} بتائیں۔}{Toby says ``an increase of $10\%$ is $\times1.1$, so a decrease of $10\%$ is $\times0.1$''. Explain why he is wrong and give the correct \ealkey{multiplier}.}
        \ashow{$\times0.1$ leaves only $10\%$, a decrease of $90\%$. A decrease of $10\%$ leaves $90\%$, so $\times0.9$.}
\end{enumerate}
\end{columns}
\end{frame}

% STARTER 2

\begin{frame}[t]{Starter}
\begin{columns}[T]

\column{0.33\textwidth}
\begin{center}
\vspace{-0.4em}
\ealpara{ایک کوٹ جس کی قیمت میں 15\% کمی کی گئی ہے اس کی قیمت £68 ہے}{A coat reduced by $15\%$ costs \pounds68}
\ealpara{آگے جانے کے لیے ضرب کریں۔ واپس جانے کے لیے \ealkeytr{ضرب کنندہ} سے تقسیم کریں۔}{Multiply to go forwards. \textbf{Divide} by the \ealkey{multiplier} to go back.}
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=1, every node/.style={font=\scriptsize}]

% ---- Chain of two multipliers ----
\node[fbox] (a0) at (0,0) {\pounds200};
\node[fbox] (a1) at (0,-1.0) {\ashowq{\pounds220}};
\node[fbox] (a2) at (0,-2.0) {\ashowq{\pounds176}};
\draw[farrow] (a0) -- node[flab,right] {$\times 1.1$} (a1);
\draw[farrow] (a1) -- node[flab,right] {$\times 0.8$} (a2);

% ---- Reversing a multiplier ----
\node[font=\small, text width=3.5cm, align=center] at (0,-3.15)
  {A coat reduced by $15\%$ costs \pounds68};
\node[rbox] (b0) at (-1.25,-4.55) {\ashowq{\pounds80}};
\node[rbox] (b1) at ( 1.25,-4.55) {\pounds68};
\draw[fwdarc] (b0) to node[flab, above] {$\times 0.85$} (b1);
\draw[bckarc] (b1) to node[flab, below] {$\div\, 0.85$} (b0);
\node[font=\scriptsize, text width=3.5cm, align=center] at (0,-6.15)
  {Multiply to go \mbox{forwards}. \textbf{Divide} by the \ealkey{multiplier} to go back.};

\end{tikzpicture}
\end{center}

\column{0.67\textwidth}
\vspace{-1.8em}
\footnotesize
\begin{enumerate}\tightlist
\begin{multicols}{2}
  \item \ealpara{45\% کو \ealkeytr{اعشاریہ} میں اور 0.06 کو \ealkeytr{فیصد} میں لکھیں۔}{Write $45\%$ as a \ealkey{decimal} and $0.06$ as a \ealkey{percentage}.}
        \ashow{$0.45$ and $6\%$}
  \columnbreak
  \item \ealpara{$\dfrac{7}{20}$ کو \ealkeytr{فیصد} میں لکھیں۔}{Write $\dfrac{7}{20}$ as a \ealkey{percentage}.}
        \ashow{$35\%$}
\end{multicols}
\begin{multicols}{2}
  \item \ealpara{پہلے فلو چارٹ کے خانوں میں گم شدہ قیمتیں لکھیں۔}{Write the missing prices in the boxes of the first flow chart.}
        \ashow{\pounds220 then \pounds176}
  \columnbreak
  \item \ealpara{3.5\% کے اضافے کے لیے \ealkeytr{ضرب کنندہ} لکھیں۔}{Write the \ealkey{multiplier} for an increase of $3.5\%$.}
        \ashow{$\times1.035$}
\end{multicols}
  \item \ealpara{ایک بائیک کی قیمت £180 ہے۔ قیمت میں 10\% اضافہ ہوتا ہے، پھر نئی قیمت میں 10\% کمی ہوتی ہے۔ حتمی قیمت، اور دونوں تبدیلیوں کے لیے واحد \ealkeytr{ضرب کنندہ} معلوم کریں۔}{A bike costs \pounds180. The price rises by $10\%$, then the new price falls by $10\%$. Find the final price, and the single \ealkey{multiplier} for the two changes together.}
        \ashow{$180\times1.1\times0.9=$ \pounds178.20; $1.1\times0.9=0.99$, a $1\%$ decrease}
\begin{multicols}{2}
  \item \ealpara{دوسرے فلو چارٹ کے خالی خانے میں کوٹ کی اصل قیمت لکھیں۔}{Write the coat's original price in the empty box of the second flow chart.}
        \ashow{$68\div0.85=$ \pounds80}
  \columnbreak
  \item \ealpara{20\% سروس چارج کے بعد ایک کھانے کی قیمت £42 ہے۔ چارج سے پہلے کی قیمت معلوم کریں۔}{A meal costs \pounds42 after a $20\%$ service charge. Find the price before the charge.}
        \ashow{$42\div1.2=$ \pounds35}
\end{multicols}
  \item \ealpara{ایک جیکٹ پر 20\% رعایت ہے، پھر ٹل پر مزید 10\% رعایت، اور قیمت £180 ہے۔ اصل قیمت معلوم کریں۔}{A jacket has $20\%$ off, then a further $10\%$ off at the till, and costs \pounds180. Find the original price.}
        \ashow{$0.8\times0.9=0.72$, so $180\div0.72=$ \pounds250.}
\end{enumerate}
\end{columns}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}[t]{Starter}

\column{0.36\textwidth}
\begin{center}
\vspace{-0.4em}
\ealpara{100\% = £80؛ 80\% = £64}{$100\%$ is \ashowq{\pounds80}; $80\%$ is \pounds64}
\ealpara{اضافہ کو واپس کرنا}{Undoing an increase}
\ealpara{\ealkeytr{ضرب کنندہ} کو واپس کرنے کے لیے، اس سے تقسیم کریں۔}{To undo a \ealkey{multiplier}, divide by it.}
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=0.66, every node/.style={font=\scriptsize}]

% ---- Reverse decrease shown as a bar model ----
\draw[topbrace] (0,0.30) -- (4.0,0.30);
\node at (2.0,0.75) {$100\%$ is \ashowq{\pounds80}};
\foreach \i in {0,...,9}{
  \ifnum\i<8
    \fill[orange!35] (\i*0.4,-0.35) rectangle ++(0.4,0.55);
  \else
    \fill[gray!15] (\i*0.4,-0.35) rectangle ++(0.4,0.55);
  \fi
  \draw (\i*0.4,-0.35) rectangle ++(0.4,0.55);
}
\draw[bottombrace, orange!80!black] (3.2,-0.45) -- (0,-0.45);
\node[orange!80!black] at (1.6,-0.90) {$80\%$ is \pounds64};

% ---- Reverse increase shown as a flow chart ----
\node[font=\small] at (2.0,-1.55) {Undoing an increase};
\node[rbox] (t0) at (-0.1,-3.30) {\ashowq{\pounds45}};
\node[rbox] (t1) at ( 4.1,-3.30) {\pounds54};
\draw[fwdarc] (t0) to node[flab, above] {$\times 1.2$} (t1);
\draw[bckarc] (t1) to node[flab, below] {$\div\, 1.2$} (t0);
\node[font=\scriptsize, text width=3.9cm, align=center] at (2.0,-5.40)
  {To undo a \ealkey{multiplier}, divide by it.};

\end{tikzpicture}
\end{center}

\column{0.64\textwidth}
\vspace{-1.8em}
\footnotesize
\begin{enumerate}\tightlist
\begin{multicols}{2}
  \item \ealpara{$\dfrac{5}{8}$ کو \ealkeytr{اعشاریہ} اور \ealkeytr{فیصد} میں لکھیں۔}{Write $\dfrac{5}{8}$ as a \ealkey{decimal} and as a \ealkey{percentage}.}
        \ashow{$0.625 = 62.5\%$}
  \columnbreak
  \item \ealpara{24\% کو \ealkeytr{کسر} کی \ealkeytr{سادہ ترین صورت} میں لکھیں۔}{Write $24\%$ as a \ealkey{fraction} in its \ealkey{simplest form}.}
        \ashow{$\tfrac{24}{100}=\tfrac{6}{25}$}
\end{multicols}
  \item \ealpara{ایک قیمت میں 20\% کمی کر کے £64 کر دی جاتی ہے۔ \ealkeytr{بار ماڈل} سے زنجیر مکمل کریں۔}{A price is reduced by $20\%$ to \pounds64. Complete the chain from the \ealkey{bar model}.}
  \vspace{-0.2em}
  \ealpara{80\% = £64؛ 10\% = £8؛ 100\% = £80}{$80\%$ is \pounds64; $10\%$ is \ablank{\pounds8}; $100\%$ is \ablank{\pounds80}}
  \begin{center}
    $80\%$ is \pounds64\\[1pt]
    $10\%$ is \ablank{\pounds8}\\[1pt]
    $100\%$ is \ablank{\pounds80}
  \end{center}
  \vspace{-0.2em}
  \item \ealpara{ایک قیمت میں 20\% اضافہ کر کے £54 کر دی جاتی ہے۔ فلو چارٹ کے خالی خانے میں اصل قیمت لکھیں۔}{A price is increased by $20\%$ to \pounds54. Write the original price in the empty box of the flow chart.}
        \ashow{$54\div1.2=$ \pounds45}
\begin{multicols}{2}
  \item \ealpara{15\% کمی کے بعد ایک جیکٹ کی قیمت £68 ہے۔ اصل قیمت معلوم کریں۔}{A jacket costs \pounds68 after a $15\%$ reduction. Find the original price.}
        \ashow{$68\div0.85=$ \pounds80}
  \columnbreak
  \item \ealpara{ایک تنخواہ میں 4\% اضافہ کر کے £33,280 ہو جاتی ہے۔ اضافے سے پہلے کی تنخواہ معلوم کریں۔}{A salary rises by $4\%$ to \pounds33\,280. Find the salary before the rise.}
        \ashow{$33\,280\div1.04=$ \pounds32\,000}
\end{multicols}
  \item \ealpara{سیم کہتا ہے ``25\% کمی کے بعد ایک کوٹ کی قیمت £60 ہے، تو اصل قیمت $60+25\%$ of $60=$ £75 تھی''۔ سیم کی غلطی کی وضاحت کریں اور درست اصل قیمت معلوم کریں۔}{Sam says ``a coat reduced by $25\%$ costs \pounds60, so the original price was $60+25\%$ of $60=$ \pounds75''. Explain Sam's mistake and find the correct original price.}
        \ashow{The $25\%$ was taken off the original price, not off \pounds60. \pounds60 is $75\%$, so $60\div0.75=$ \pounds80.}
\end{enumerate}
\end{columns}
\end{frame}

Account B pays $5\%$ simple, no maximum. Dev saves \pounds1000 for 3 years. Which is better, and by how much?}
        \ashow{A: \pounds390 plus the \pounds700 that earns nothing, so \pounds1090.
